messages:
Elaine (Sales): FYI Acme booked a live demo next Wed. They want the POC to look identical to production traffic. Could we temporarily bump their Dedicated pool and allow a burst window for the demo?
Juan (Solutions Eng): What numbers are they expecting? QPS or concurrency? Also do they need a scoped API key or will they run from our demo environment?
Elaine (Sales): They said ~250 concurrent sessions for 30 minutes during the demo window. They'll use their app with an API key — prefer a scoped key tied to the acme-poc project.
Mike (Infra): We can resize their Dedicated pool and enable short burst. Propose: increase from 2 -> 4 GPUs and enable a 72h burst window at +25% capacity. We'll pin model to rwd-v1-small for predictability.
Kevin (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Make sure autoscale policy has a hard cap to avoid runaway costs. Example config we can push:```yaml
dedicated_pool: acme-poc
  gpus: 4
  model: rwd-v1-small
  autoscale:
    min_replicas: 2
    max_replicas: 4
    scale_metric: rps
  burst:
    enabled: true
    percent: 25
    window_hours: 72
```
Mike (Infra): I'll apply that and run a smoke test. Need a signed SOW or commit note for finance if we exceed baseline reserved capacity.
Simon (Finance): For a short POC bump we do pro-rated billing. Rough estimate: add ~0.75 GPU-days per extra GPU for the 72h window (we'll send exact numbers). Also need PO or approval email to avoid post-demo invoice surprises.
Elaine (Sales): I'll get sign-off from Acme and attach approval here by EOD.
Juan (Solutions Eng): For the scoped API key: create a key scoped to project "acme-poc" with only inference.generate permissions and no data export. CLI:```bash
rwctl keys create --project acme-poc --scope inference.generate --note "acme demo key"
```
Mike (Infra): Created infra ticket #INF-1192 to resize pool and apply burst policy. Assigning to me. I'll also add a canary route to divert 10% traffic to the new pool for the first hour.
deploy-bot: INF-1192 status: in_progress (owner: Mike)
Kevin (Eng): Heads-up: if they push long-context prompts it may increase memory pressure. We'll add KV cache size guard and enforce max_seq_len=2048 in model config.
Elaine (Sales): Acme approved email attached: "Approved: increase pool and demo burst". Simon, consider that the approval.
Simon (Finance): Got it, will flag as approved for the 72h demo window. I'll prepare the pro-forma and drop it in the thread.
Juan (Solutions Eng): Can someone add demo runbook steps? Quick checklist: 1) scoped key provisioned 2) pool resized + burst enabled 3) canary routing 4) smoke test 5) short post-demo cost review.
Mike (Infra): I'll post smoke test logs when ready. ETA provisioning done by Tue 18:00 PST.
Elaine (Sales): Thanks — please @ me when done. :thumbsup:
Kevin (Eng): One more: restrict rollback policy to immediate fallback to hosted rwd-v1-small-compat if pool fails. That prevents failed requests during the demo.
Mike (Infra): Added fallback to hosted model and documented in INF-1192. Closing notes: provisioning complete will be in the ticket.
Elaine (Sales): Great, team. Demo checklist looks good. Meeting invite for the handoff call sent to Acme + internal SRE/SE for Tue 18:30 PST. :eyes:
